intro: When your building's accessible entry systems stop functioning properly, timely ADA door repair in Arlington becomes a top priority for property managers and business owners alike. From automatic door operators that fail to open smoothly to threshold hardware in need of adjustment, accessibility-related door problems can disrupt daily operations and create liability concerns. Commercial Glass Door & Window Repair Service provides prompt, professional solutions for commercial and residential properties throughout Arlington, VA. Whether you manage a high-rise near Rosslyn or a retail strip in Ballston, our licensed and insured team is ready to restore safe, reliable access to your building.

sections.heading: Why ADA Door Repair Matters for Arlington Properties
sections.body: Accessible door systems are a critical component of any commercial or public-facing building. Automatic door operators, low-threshold hardware, lever-style handles, and proper door-closing speeds all play a role in ensuring that entrances remain usable for every visitor, tenant, or employee. When these components wear out, malfunction, or sustain damage, the impact on daily building operations can be significant. Property managers across Arlington know that deferred maintenance on accessible entry systems can escalate quickly from a minor inconvenience into a larger problem. Our team works with building owners, general contractors, and facility managers to diagnose issues accurately and implement repairs that restore proper function. We service a wide variety of door types including storefront glass doors, aluminum-framed entry systems, and heavy-duty commercial swinging doors. By addressing problems early, you help maintain smooth, uninterrupted access for all occupants and visitors to your property.

sections.heading: Commercial ADA Door Repair Services We Provide
sections.body: Our commercial ADA door repair services in Arlington cover the full range of components that keep accessible entryways functioning correctly. This includes automatic door operator repair and replacement, door closer adjustment and replacement, threshold leveling, panic hardware servicing, and frame realignment after impact damage. Glass storefront doors with automatic or assisted-open features are among the most common systems we service, particularly in office buildings, medical facilities, retail centers, and mixed-use developments. We also handle repairs to narrow-stile aluminum doors frequently found in older Arlington commercial properties. Our technicians carry a broad inventory of replacement parts for leading door hardware brands, which helps minimize downtime on busy commercial sites. Whether you are dealing with a door that drifts open, fails to latch, or operates at an unsafe speed, our team can quickly identify the root cause and execute a reliable repair.

sections.heading: Serving Neighborhoods and Landmarks Across Arlington
sections.body: Commercial Glass Door & Window Repair Service is proud to serve property owners and managers throughout Arlington, including high-traffic commercial corridors near Rosslyn, the Ballston Quarter, Crystal City, Courthouse, and Pentagon City. We regularly work on office towers, government-adjacent facilities, retail storefronts, apartment complexes, and healthcare buildings throughout the county. Our familiarity with the types of commercial construction common in Arlington — from mid-century office parks to newer mixed-use high-rises — means we arrive prepared for the specific door systems in use at your location. We understand that many Arlington properties operate on tight schedules with minimal tolerance for extended downtime, so we prioritize efficient, professional service. Our licensed and insured technicians work cleanly and professionally on-site, respecting tenants, customers, and building staff throughout the repair process.

sections.heading: Residential ADA Door Repairs for Arlington Homeowners
sections.body: Accessibility isn't exclusively a commercial concern. Homeowners in Arlington increasingly seek modifications and repairs that make their residences safer and more navigable for family members with mobility considerations. We assist residential clients with door hardware adjustments, threshold modifications, and door closer installations that reduce the effort required to open and close entry doors. If your current door frame or glass door panel has been damaged and is affecting smooth operation, our team can assess whether repair or replacement is the most practical solution. We work on patio doors, sliding glass doors, and hinged exterior doors to ensure they operate with minimal resistance and appropriate closing speed. Our team serves homeowners throughout Arlington neighborhoods including Shirlington, Lyon Village, and beyond, bringing the same level of care and professionalism to residential projects that we apply on large commercial sites.

sections.heading: What to Expect When You Call Us for ADA Door Repair in Arlington
sections.body: When you contact Commercial Glass Door & Window Repair Service, you can expect a straightforward process designed to get your door functioning properly as quickly as possible. We begin with a thorough on-site assessment to identify all components contributing to the problem, rather than simply addressing the most visible symptom. Our technicians will walk you through findings and recommended repairs before any work begins, so there are no surprises. We carry common replacement parts for door operators, closers, pivots, and hardware on our service vehicles to handle many repairs in a single visit. For more complex jobs involving custom glass panels or specialty hardware, we will provide a clear timeline and keep you updated throughout the process. We serve clients across Arlington on both an emergency and scheduled basis, and our team is licensed and insured for your peace of mind.

faq.q: What types of doors do you repair for ADA accessibility in Arlington?
faq.a: We repair a wide range of door types including automatic sliding doors, swing-style storefront glass doors, aluminum-framed commercial entries, and residential exterior doors. Our services cover door operators, closers, thresholds, pivot hardware, panic devices, and related components.

faq.q: Do you offer emergency ADA door repair services in Arlington?
faq.a: Yes, we offer both scheduled and emergency repair services throughout Arlington. If your accessible entry system has failed and is affecting building operations or occupant safety, contact us at (202) 929-2890 and we will work to get a technician to your location promptly.

faq.q: Can you repair automatic door openers on commercial glass doors?
faq.a: Absolutely. Automatic door operator repair and replacement is one of our most common services. We work on powered swing door operators, sliding door drive systems, and related sensors and controls. Our technicians are experienced with the systems found in Arlington office buildings, retail centers, and medical facilities.

faq.q: Do you serve residential properties in Arlington as well as commercial ones?
faq.a: Yes. While much of our ADA door repair work involves commercial properties, we also assist Arlington homeowners who need door hardware adjustments, threshold modifications, or closer installations to improve accessibility and ease of operation at their residences.
